'''Ben Saunders Bothawui Operatives''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Ben Saunders]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls50.htm Bothawui Operatives], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]).
